positive.title: Your budget is looking good!
body: Here are some other ways to try and boost your money, so you’re even better prepared for the unexpected. This includes tips to pay less tax, save more and how to plan for retirement.
Your budget summary is below. You can save this to access another time.

neutral.title: Good news, your budget balances
body: But there's still room to free up some extra money in your budget. Follow our tips to help improve your finances and save for unexpected costs.
Your budget summary is below. You can save this to access another time.

negative.title: At the moment, you've got more going out than coming in.
body: Don't worry, here are ways to help get you back on track.
Your budget summary is below. You can save this to access another time.

take-control-of-your-spending.title: Take control of your spending
take-control-of-your-spending.text: Our [Beginner's guide to managing your money_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/everyday-money/budgeting/beginners-guide-to-managing-your-money) is a great place to start - see how much you could save.

save-money-on-your-household-bills.title: Save money on your household bills
save-money-on-your-household-bills.text: Like energy, water, Council Tax, phone and broadband bills. Find [easy ways to cut costs _target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/everyday-money/budgeting/how-to-save-money-on-household-bills)- you could save £100s each year.

build-your-emergency-savings-buffer.title: Build your emergency savings buffer
build-your-emergency-savings-buffer.text: If you have some money left over in your budget, it’s a good idea to save it for a rainy day. Find out [how to build up an emergency fund_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/savings/types-of-savings/emergency-savings-how-much-is-enough).

make-the-most-of-your-savings.title: Make the most of your savings
make-the-most-of-your-savings.text: Learn [how to find the best savings accounts_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/savings/how-to-save/cash-savings-at-a-glance) and compare top rates.

review-your-pension-savings.title: Review your pension savings
review-your-pension-savings.text: Find out how to [grow your pension pot_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/pensions-and-retirement/building-your-retirement-pot/making-the-most-of-your-pensions). You'll learn about tax relief, how contributions work and [how much pension you'll need to retire comfortably_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/pensions-and-retirement/building-your-retirement-pot/how-to-increase-your-pension-savings).

maximise-your-income.title: Maximise your income
maximise-your-income.text: Learn how to cut costs and find extra help that's available in our guide [Living on a squeezed income_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/money-troubles/cost-of-living/squeezed-income).

talk-to-your-creditor.title: Talk to your creditor
talk-to-your-creditor.text: If you think you can't afford to pay a bill, always [contact the company to ask for help _target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/money-troubles/cost-of-living/talking-to-your-creditor)before missing a payment. They can then put a plan in place to help you.

prioritise-repaying-your-debts.title: Prioritise repaying your debts
prioritise-repaying-your-debts.text: If you have debts, find out what to do if you're [automatically enrolled in your employer's workplace_target=_self](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/pensions-and-retirement/auto-enrolment/automatic-enrolment-if-you-have-debts).

benefits-calculator.title: Use our benefits calculator
benefits-calculator.text: Quickly find out what benefits and other support you could get - and how to claim them.

savings-calculator.title: Use our savings calculator
savings-calculator.text: Work out how long it’ll take to save up for something, and how much you’d need to regularly save

bill-prioritiser.title: Get help with your bills
bill-prioritiser.text: Use our Bill prioritiser to work out which bills and payments you need to deal with first - plus how to avoid missing payments.

debt-advice-locator.title: Talk to a debt adviser
debt-advice-locator.text: Worried about debt? You’re not alone. Find out where to get free, confidential help near you, online or on the phone.

no-summary.heading: It looks like you haven't included any details of your spending habits
no-summary.text: It only takes a few minutes to add them in and then you'll get a breakdown of your budget and tailored guidance.
